For my GIS class I worked with a group of four others to determine potential suitable sites for wind turbines in Alabama. Finding a suitable site involved considering multiple factors such as proximity to human residencies, wind speed, and land use type. To generate a layer of suitable sites, my job was to develop a model builder to process the different layers and perform a raster calculator to highlight potential suitable sites.\newline

You can scroll through our story map, which shows the context of our project and our results [here](https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/5e37c758940e4fb3a4b95589dd674e57)
